name: bloodthirsty_conqueror_gains_only_from_opponents_losses
notes: M4 mapper. Printed: 'Whenever an opponent loses life, you gain that much life. (Damage causes loss of life.)' Support card: FDN Massacre Wurm (verified; 'Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, that player loses 2 life.'). Seat 0 controls Bloodthirsty Conqueror and Massacre Wurm. Seat 1's Bear dies: the Wurm makes seat 1 lose 2 life (a loss with no damage) and the Conqueror gains seat 0 that much: seat 0 at 22, seat 1 at 18.
